facts.name: Susan L. Barber
facts.assignment: Hardee administrative judge, Section03: civil, family, felony, juvenile, mental health and probate, as listed on official profile.

procedure_checklist.hearing_scheduling: Email the assistant with all parties copied, identifying filed matter, required time, case number and parties. Coordinate dates outside the court email chain, then obtain court confirmation. Notify the office promptly of cancellations or duration changes.
procedure_checklist.conferral: Coordinate hearing availability and duration with all parties. The manual separately specifies conferral for motions in limine; no general merits-conferral rule inferred from that provision.
procedure_checklist.motion_submissions: File original matters with the clerk; the office warns docket images may take3–5days and may require an emailed courtesy copy. Follow linked manual for specialized submissions.
procedure_checklist.proposed_orders: Submit through the Florida e-filing portal with supporting motion and explanatory cover letter. Prior assistant approval permits Word email submission for those unable to use the portal. General instructions reject mailed hard-copy orders; specialized foreclosure language differs, preserved below.
procedure_checklist.courtesy_copies: Provide the hearing notice to chambers after confirmation and include in-person instructions even when remote appearance is authorized. See linked manual for specialized material deadlines.
procedure_checklist.remote_appearances: Manual permits Teams for non-evidentiary hearings shorter than30minutes; other remote appearances require permission. Evidentiary or longer-than30minute hearings are in person absent special authorization. Camera and microphone required; exactly30minutes is not expressly addressed by those thresholds.
procedure_checklist.chambers_communications: Use assistant email for scheduling and approved submissions. Submit orders once; status inquiry allowed after one week without communication or entry. CourtroomB ordinarily used.

conflicts: PDF page3 specialized foreclosure instructions request mailed judgment packets including a proposed final judgment and conforming copies; pages4–5 general proposed-order instructions require portal submission and reject mailed hard copies. Both retained without deciding precedence.
PDF is captioned Judge Susan L.Barber but page5 emergency paragraph names Judge Rafool. Identity wording retained without attributing a new Hardee assignment.
PDF page6 states a10-day rehearing period under Rule1.530(b). Preserved as a source statement, not adopted as the current rule or independently resolved.
limitations: Stated revision January23,2026; profile has no distinct stated revision/effective date. No inference that every statement is current merely because document is linked.
